title: Best practices for isothermal titration calorimetry of protein-DNA interactions

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Best practices for isothermal titration calorimetry of protein-DNA interactions》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) is a powerful label-free method for quantifying protein-DNA interactions, providing direct measurements of binding affinity, stoichiometry, enthalpy, and entropy in a single experiment.
